tasks.name: Calc Control Book Metrics

params.failureMessage: Assert Control Book Schema failed
params.expectedColumns: As of Date, Shares Issued, Issued & Outstanding, Comment

guards.name: Warn EQ Control Book Comment Spelling Variants

params.sql:
select case
  when (select count(*) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')) = 0 then '0 行'
  else concat('影响 ', (select count(*) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')), ' 行 / ', (select sum([Shares Issued]) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')), ' 股，Comment 拼写为：', '
', (select group_concat(distinct [Comment] separator '
') from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')))
end as comment_variant_hint
params.failureMessage:
EQ Control Book 的 Comment 列发现与规范写法不一致的 Omnibus 拼写（例如 Ominibus）。
这些行已按模糊匹配计入 2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu，本次汇总数值不受影响、无需重算。
建议在源数据（Shareworks 控制账簿导出）中把 Comment 改成规范写法 "Omnibus Inc. Pl"，否则以后每个月都会在此停下确认。
（空格、标点与大小写差异视为格式差异，不算拼写变体：Omnibus Inc.Pl. 等写法会被直接接受。）

guards.name: Warn Duplicate BC Subplan Transfer Rows

params.sql:
select case
  when (select count(*) from (select 1 from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by wf_date_key([As of Date]), wf_date_key([Process Date]), [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) g) = 0 then '0 组'
  else concat('发现 ',
    (select count(*) from (select 1 from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by wf_date_key([As of Date]), wf_date_key([Process Date]), [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) g), ' 组重复的 BC Subplan transfer，已按一笔计入：',
    (select group_concat(distinct h separator '；') from (
       select concat(cast(k.[As of Date] as string), ' / ', cast(k.[Shares Issued] as string), ' 股') as h
         from (select wf_date_key([As of Date]) as [As of Date], [Shares Issued] as [Shares Issued] from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by wf_date_key([As of Date]), wf_date_key([Process Date]), [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) k
     ) t))
end as bc_duplicate_hint
from {control_book}
limit 1
params.failureMessage:
EQ Control Book 里同一笔 BC Subplan transfer 出现了多行（同 As of Date、同股数、同期末余额），本次已按一笔计入，「2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu」的数值不受影响。
常见原因是 base 与当月增量用了两种导出格式（例如一行是 BOOK ENTRY ISSUANCE、另一行是 O.I.），合并时无法识别为同一笔。
建议在源数据中删除重复行；确认后继续即可。

params.sql:
select
  (select [Issued & Outstanding] from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as eom_eq_balance_os,
  (select [Issued & Outstanding] from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) < {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as last_month_eq_balance_os,
  (select wf_month_key([As of Date]) from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as last_control_book_month,
  coalesce((select sum(t.[Shares Issued]) from (
    select wf_date_key([As of Date]) as [As of Date], wf_date_key([Process Date]) as [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding]
    from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth})
    group by wf_date_key([As of Date]), wf_date_key([Process Date]), [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding]
  ) t), 0) as bc_subplan_transfer_control_book,
  coalesce(max(case when [Trans. Type] = 'Agr. & Pl. of Merger'
    and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) then [Shares Issued] else null end), 0) as cullgen_common_stock,
  coalesce(max(case when [Comment] = 'Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology'
    and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) then [Shares Issued] else null end), 0) as gyre_2023_china_subplan_total
from {control_book}

tasks.description: 从合并后的 EQ Control Book 汇总当月指标：EOM / Last Month 余额、2025 BC Subplan transfer、Cullgen common stock 与 Gyre 2023 China SubPlan 总数全部按 As of Date 截断到 workflow 月份（同一份完整 Control Book 可回算任意历史月份）。BC Subplan transfer 按 Comment 模糊匹配 Omnibus / Ominibus 的 Shares Issued 求和，并按「经济指纹」（日历日 As of Date + Process Date + Shares Issued + Issued & Outstanding）去重：同一笔转账在 base 与增量两种导出格式里各出现一次时要算一笔；真正的两笔同股数转账期末余额不同，仍各自计入。重复行会在运行页给出 warning。Cullgen common stock 取 Trans. Type = Agr. & Pl. of Merger 的 Shares Issued，合并发生前该月为 0（合并行 2026-05 才出现）；Gyre 2023 China SubPlan 总数同理取 Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology 行，该行出现前为 0。

guards.name: Warn Futu Exercises Dated After The Run Month

params.sql:
select case
  when (select count(*) from {futu} where wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) > {constants.workflowMonth}) = 0 then '0 行'
  else concat('已排除 ',
    (select count(*) from {futu} where wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) > {constants.workflowMonth}), ' 行 / ',
    (select sum([Exercised Qty]) from {futu} where wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) > {constants.workflowMonth}), ' 股（行权日期晚于 ', {constants.workflowMonth}, '，涉及月份：',
    (select group_concat(distinct m separator ', ') from (select wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) as m from {futu} where wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([Exercise Date]) > {constants.workflowMonth}) t), '）')
end as futu_future_rows_hint
from {futu}
limit 1
params.failureMessage:
Futu 行权表里有行权日期晚于运行月份的记录（见下文实际值），本次已按 Exercise Date 截断、不计入 BCI Shares Held by Futu 的扣减。
这通常是绑定的底表本身就是「到当日」的合并结果，属正常现象，确认后继续即可。
（BCI = China Subplan total − 截至运行月份的已行权数量；若这些晚于本月的行权本应计入，请检查运行月份是否选错。）

tasks.description: 计算 Futu 已行权总数以及 BCI Shares Held by Futu。行权数量按 Exercise Date 截断到运行月份（与 Control Book 的 As of Date 口径一致，因此同一份合并底表可回算任意历史月份）；日期为空的行按计入处理，晚于运行月份的行不计入并在运行页给出 warning。

tasks.name: Calc Option Plan Metrics

params.failureMessage: Assert Option Plan Schema failed
Plan Summary Metrics 缺少 plan_name 或 outstanding 列

params.sql:
select
  coalesce((select sum(s.outstanding) from {summary} s), 0) as total_options_outstanding,
  coalesce((select sum(p.[value]) from {plans} p where p.key = 'Shares Remaining For Issuance'), 0) as total_options_available,
  coalesce((select sum(s.outstanding) from {summary} s), 0)
    + coalesce((select sum(p.[value]) from {plans} p where p.key = 'Shares Remaining For Issuance'), 0) as total_options_outstanding_plus_available

tasks.description: 期权合计：Outstanding 取 Plan Summary Metrics 的 outstanding 之和（已按台账覆盖 Cancelled 并由 Granted + Exercised + Cancelled 重算），Available 取源表 Shares Remaining For Issuance。

tasks.name: Calc Business Inputs

params.sql: select case when cullgen_common_stock = {constants.cullgenCommonStock} then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Cullgen common stock 与月度固定参数 cullgen_common_stock 不一致（对账失败，已阻断）。Control Book 按 As of Date 截断后该列见下文实际值；合并发生前（2026-05 之前）该值应为 0。请核对 Control Book 的 Agr. & Pl. of Merger 行，或到月度页面修正该固定参数。

params.sql: select case when gyre_2023_china_subplan_total = {constants.gyre2023ChinaSubplanTotal} then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Gyre 2023 China SubPlan total 与月度固定参数 gyre_2023_china_subplan_total 不一致（对账失败，已阻断）。两类值的实际值见下文；Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology 行出现前（2024-07 之前）该值应为 0。请核对 Control Book 或到月度页面修正该固定参数。

params.sql:
select
  max(c.eom_eq_balance_os) as eom_eq_balance_os,
  max(c.cullgen_common_stock) as cullgen_common_stock,
  max(c.gyre_2023_china_subplan_total) as gyre_2023_china_subplan_total,
  max(c.bc_subplan_transfer_control_book) as bc_subplan_transfer_selected,
  'control_book' as bc_subplan_transfer_selection_source,
  {constants.warrantsConvertiblePreferred} as warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock,
  max(s.series_b_preferred_stock) as series_b_preferred_stock,
  {constants.optionsOutstandingCullgen} as options_outstanding_cullgen,
  {constants.optionsAvailableCullgen} as options_available_cullgen,
  round(max(c.eom_eq_balance_os) + max(o.total_options_outstanding) + {constants.warrantsConvertiblePreferred} + max(s.series_b_preferred_stock) - max(c.bc_subplan_transfer_control_book) + max(o.total_options_available) + {constants.optionsOutstandingCullgen} + {constants.optionsAvailableCullgen}, 0) as total_fully_diluted
from {control_metrics} c, {option_metrics} o, {series_b_metrics} s

tasks.description: 汇总 Summary 计算所需业务输入；Series B Preferred Stock 来自 Read SERIES B 的 Shares Issued 合计乘以 5，其余固定值来自 global parameters，Gyre option totals 由 raw option plans workbook 与 cancellation 调整计算。

tasks.name: Assert EQ Control Book Workflow Month

params.sql:
select case
  when last_control_book_month is null then 0
  when cast(substr(last_control_book_month, 1, 4) as number) * 12 + cast(substr(last_control_book_month, 6, 2) as number) >= cast(substr({constants.workflowMonth}, 1, 4) as number) * 12 + cast(substr({constants.workflowMonth}, 6, 2) as number) - 1 then 1
  else 0
end as actual
from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: EQ Control Book 输入文件错月：忽略运行月份之后的行后，最后一条 Issued & Outstanding 所属月份比运行月份早了一个月以上（允许「本月无交易、沿用上月余额」，即最后一个月是运行月份或它的上一个月）。请检查绑定的是不是当月的 Control Book。

tasks.description: 阻断错月输入：忽略 workflow 月份之后的数据后，EQ Control Book 最后一条有效 Issued & Outstanding 的 As of Date 必须属于 workflow 月份或其上一个月。允许「本月没有 Control Book 更新」的情形——没有交易时账簿不会新增行，余额沿用上月，这是正常状态而不是输入错误；比上一个月更早才说明绑错了文件。

tasks.name: Build Capitalization Summary

guards.name: Assert Total Fully Diluted Business Input

params.sql: select case when total_fully_diluted > 0 then 1 else 0 end as actual from {business_inputs}
params.failureMessage: Assert total fully diluted business input failed

params.sql: select case when options_outstanding_cullgen + options_available_cullgen = {constants.cullgenOutstanding} + {constants.cullgenAvailable} then 1 else 0 end as actual from {business_inputs}
params.failureMessage: Cullgen option business inputs do not match global parameters

params.sql: select case when bc_subplan_transfer_control_book >= 0 then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Control Book 的 2025 BC Subplan transfer 缺失（为空）：无法计算 Total Fully Diluted 中的扣减项。0 是允许的（转仓发生前的月份），只有空值才阻断。

params.sql:
select '' as Number, 'Issued Shares -Equity Asset Class' as Description,
  null as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs}
union all select '' as Number, 'Asset Class Summary: EOM' as Description,
  b.eom_eq_balance_os as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '1' as Number, 'Common Shares OS' as Description,
  b.eom_eq_balance_os - b.cullgen_common_stock - f.bci_shares_held_by_futu - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  (b.eom_eq_balance_os - b.cullgen_common_stock - f.bci_shares_held_by_futu - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected) / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {futu_metrics} f, {business_inputs} b
union all select '2' as Number, 'Cullgen common stock' as Description,
  b.cullgen_common_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.cullgen_common_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '3' as Number, 'BCI Shares Held by Futu' as Description,
  f.bci_shares_held_by_futu as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  f.bci_shares_held_by_futu / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {futu_metrics} f, {business_inputs} b
union all select '4' as Number, '2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu' as Description,
  b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '' as Number, 'Derivative Equity Incentives' as Description,
  null as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs}
union all select '5' as Number, 'Warrants for Convertible Preferred Stock' as Description,
  b.warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '6' as Number, 'Series B Preferred Stock' as Description,
  b.series_b_preferred_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.series_b_preferred_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '7' as Number, 'Options Outstanding- Gyre' as Description,
  o.total_options_outstanding - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  (o.total_options_outstanding - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected) / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {option_metrics} o, {business_inputs} b
union all select '8' as Number, 'Options Available- Gyre' as Description,
  o.total_options_available as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  o.total_options_available / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {option_metrics} o, {business_inputs} b
union all select '9' as Number, 'Options Outstanding- Cullgen' as Description,
  b.options_outstanding_cullgen as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.options_outstanding_cullgen / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '10' as Number, 'Options Available- Cullgen' as Description,
  b.options_available_cullgen as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.options_available_cullgen / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '' as Number, 'Total Fully Diluted Shares Outstand' as Description,
  b.total_fully_diluted as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  1 as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b

tasks.name: Invoke Grant Record Sync
tasks.description: 调用 ESOP 授予记录同步，写出本月「授予记录」快照（月份透传，文件名带月份后缀）。两个来源都可选：都未提供时跳过，任一提供则执行。

tasks.name: Invoke Employee Import
tasks.description: 用本月已收集的两份授予导出刷新员工主数据（员工归集：按工号 UPSERT，幂等）。两份都没提供时跳过；只提供一份时按该来源归集。

month.label: Month
month.description: 用于生成月度输出文件名前缀，例如 2026-05-Capitalization_Table_Summary_View.xlsx。

series_b.label: SERIES B Control Book
series_b.defaultSheetName: CB Details Sort By Process Date
series_b.description: 必填：本月 SERIES B Control Book 导出（SeriesB_Control_Books_Detail_Data_DD.MM.YYYY_HH.mm.xlsx）。系统读股东级明细并入累计台账，用 43105 汇总 sheet 对账；Series B Preferred Stock =（累计 Shares Issued − 累计 Shares Retired）× 5。未提供时月度运行会被拦下（Missing source binding: series_b）。

base_control_book.label: Control Book Summary
base_control_book.description: 完整的 EQ Control Book，作为增量合并的基表；一般由上月结果自动带出，也可手动换成新的 Cap Table 文件。

base_futu_exercises.label: Futu Exercises Summary
base_futu_exercises.description: 完整的 Futu BCI Exercises 基表，作为增量合并的基表；一般由上月结果自动带出，也可手动设置。

option_plans_summary.label: Gyre Option Plans Summary
option_plans_summary.description: 各计划的 outstanding 与 available 股数，用于计算 Options Outstanding / Available。

incremental_control_book.label: Control Book Detail
incremental_control_book.description: 必填：本月 Control Book 明细导出，合并进基表；报告期必须是本月，否则运行会被拦下。本月即使没有新交易也要上传当期导出（合并结果等于基表），未提供时月度运行会被拦下（Missing source binding: incremental_control_book）。

base_cancel_restore_report.label: FUTU-Cancel & Restore Summary
base_cancel_restore_report.description: 上月完整的取消与恢复基表，默认由上月合并结果自动延续。

incremental_futu_exercises.label: Futu Exercise Record
incremental_futu_exercises.description: 富途「员工行权记录」导出。取其中的『行权汇总数据』sheet（一人一天一行，末行为合计）作为行权增量：它与基表按 员工号+授予编号+行权日期 幂等合并，同时用于「行权记录」页的 Futu 视图。不要选『行权明细数据』——那是界面导出，列契约和分页窗口会随导出状态变化。

previous_capitalization_summary.label: Previous Capitalization Summary
previous_capitalization_summary.description: 上月 Capitalization Summary，由系统按上月产出自动引入，仅用于校验本月 Last Month；无需人工上传，故不在输入列表显示。

incremental_cancel_restore_report.label: FUTU-Cancel & Restore Record
incremental_cancel_restore_report.description: 本月「取消与恢复报表」明细，用于 Plan Summary 增量合并，同时生成「取消记录」页的当月快照。

exercise_record_shareworks.label: Shareworks Exercise Record
exercise_record_shareworks.description: Shareworks「Executive Awards OS Only」导出，用于「行权记录」页的 Shareworks 视图；未提供时该视图当月为空。

sold_shares_futu.label: Futu Sold Shares Record
sold_shares_futu.description: 富途「出售汇总」导出，用于「卖出记录」页的当月快照；未提供时该页当月为空。

shareworks_grants.label: Shareworks Grant Record
shareworks_grants.description: Shareworks「Options OS Detail by Plan」导出，用于「授予记录」页的 Shareworks 视图；未提供时该视图当月为空。

futu_grants.label: Futu Grant Record
futu_grants.description: 富途「授予记录」导出，用于「授予记录」页的 Futu 视图；未提供时该视图当月为空。

sold_shares_base.description: 上一月的累计快照，由月度运行自动带出，用于和本月增量做幂等合并；无需人工上传。

base_series_b.label: SERIES B Control Book Summary
base_series_b.description: 上月的 SERIES B 累积明细台账（series_b/SeriesB_Control_Book_Base_yyyy_MM.xlsx），由 Read SERIES B 每月产出，一般自动带出；也可以手动换成一份新的累积文件。首次运行没有 base 时，直接由当月 SERIES B 明细导出建立。
